name: Ghest
tagline: Track loans and fixed payments: where you are and when they end, fully offline
blurb: Ghest tracks fixed recurring payments with a known end — loans, car finance, tuition, a phone on instalments — and shows where you are in each one and when the money frees up.
description:
Ghest tracks fixed recurring payments with a known end — loans, car finance, tuition, a phone on instalments — and shows where you are in each one and when the money frees up.

For each commitment

• Payments made and left, as a progress grid

• Principal and interest still to pay

• Last payment made, next payment, final payment

Across everything

• Total left to repay and what you pay per month, normalised across daily, weekly, monthly and yearly payments

• The date everything ends

• A lump-sum calculator: how much interest an extra payment saves on each loan and how many months it cuts, with the best option highlighted

Details that matter

• Persian and English, right-to-left and left-to-right

• Solar Hijri, Gregorian and Lunar Hijri calendars, both for payment days and for display. A payment on the 31st lands on the last day of shorter months.

• Any currency, including toman, and a different currency per commitment if you need it

Private by design
The app has no internet permission. No accounts, no analytics, no crash reporting. Your data stays on your phone; export it to a JSON file whenever you like and import it on another device.
